notes: CANONICAL for Sofia Nilsdotter (b. 16 Jan 1805, Haga, Stala / d. 26 Jan 1887, Hjälmvik Ng, Stala), wife of Samuel Jacobsson. DUPLICATE exists as I182382755760 - same birth/death, but that copy has only one parent (Greta Nilsdotter, I182650548639) and no sources. This record carries both parents (Nils Olafsson I182195861313 + Greta Nilsdotter I182195861335) and the sourced 13 May 1836 marriage record (S446914557). Kept as primary.

See docs/research/ancestors/gen07-samuel-jacobsson.md. Note her mother Greta Nilsdotter is herself a separately-tracked duplicate-person pair (I182195861335 here vs. I182650548639 on the duplicate Sofia record) - gen-8 issue, not resolved by this pass.
